chunks: So had many an earlier people gone astray,
ai.seo_question: Who went astray before the people of Surah As-Saff?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah As-Saff highlights the prevalence of misguidance among earlier nations, serving as a cautionary precedent for the believers to remain steadfast in their covenant with God. It underscores the historical pattern where divine messengers were often rejected by the majority, reinforcing the need for vigilance against deviation. This context emphasizes the continuity of the struggle between truth and falsehood across different eras.
